title: Notes for a Community Exhibition
paragraphs: The community center was planning an exhibition about everyday experiences. Students volunteered to select the written material. Their challenge was to find a balance between vivid individual moments and a larger theme that visitors could follow without already knowing the people involved.

Several records provided a starting point for the discussion. He agreed to acknowledge the error instead of pretending it had not happened. The committee will administer the fund and decide how the money is used. The volunteers advocate better protection for the endangered forest. The student could articulate her idea clearly so everyone understood it.

Other records complicated that first impression and encouraged a closer reading. Researchers attribute the improved growth to the richer soil. Scientists classify these animals according to shared physical characteristics. Please elaborate on your proposal by explaining how each stage would work. The school will implement the new timetable at the start of term.

The editors resisted the temptation to turn the collection into a single simple rule. Each account had its own circumstances, and those circumstances mattered. Their finished feature encouraged readers to describe what they noticed, support an interpretation with evidence, and compare it with another possible explanation. The value of the collection lay in that patient work of comparison.

targets.definition: to recognize or admit as true
to manage the operation of something
to publicly support a proposal or cause
to regard as caused by something
to arrange into groups based on features
to add further details to an explanation
to put a plan into action
